description: Source code for the LicenseAgreementStep class, a UI component in the Android SDK wizard for reviewing and accepting license agreements for components to be installed.

classes.name: LicenseAgreementStep
classes.description: A wizard step for reviewing and accepting license agreements, displaying a tree of licenses and associated changes, with accept/decline options.

classes.name: Change
classes.description: Represents a change (install, update, remove) of a package with associated license information.

classes.name: ChangeType
classes.description: Enumeration of change types: INSTALL, UPDATE, REMOVE.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the UI components, sets up event listeners, and populates the license change list.

methods.name: isStepVisible
methods.description: Determines if the step should be visible based on the presence of install requests.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Checks if all licenses have been accepted before proceeding.

methods.name: getStepName
methods.description: Returns the display name of the step.

methods.name: setChanges
methods.description: Populates the tree with license changes and associated license information.

methods.name: onEnterStep
methods.description: Refreshes the list of changes when the step is entered.

methods.name: getPreferredFocusedComponent
methods.description: Returns the component to focus when the step is active.
